description: Configure the ticker watchlist and severity threshold for push catalyst alerts delivered to your configured webhook (via set_webhook) and used by Marx's monitoring cadence. Requires the connection's x-api-key header.

enabled.description: Enable or pause watchlist push alerts.

minSeverity.description: Minimum alert severity to push: low | medium | high | critical (default: high).

types.description: Optional subset of catalyst change types to receive.

name: manage_watchlist
title: Manage Catalyst Watchlist
